pretreatments.description: grinding (milling) the dried pine needles in an electric blender. Sieved through (20 mesh size).
autoclaving of pine needles in flask plugged with non-absorbent cotton at 121 °C for 30 min.
Repeated exposure of LCB to acid (HCl) and alkali (NaOH) (acid–base–acid treatment) with 30 min cycles, until the wash out liquid was clear.
